text:
maria-people: Hey team — quick policy question. I'm relocating from the UK to Spain and my move window is Dec 27–Jan 5. My manager approved 10 days relocation leave but that overlaps the year-end shutdown. Do I have any PTO carryover or pro‑rated accrual options? I started Sept 15, so I didn't hit a full year yet.

ola-people: Congrats on the move! :party_parrot: Quick clarifying q: is the relocation leave going to be unpaid or are you using PTO for some of that window?

maria-people: Manager approved unpaid relocation leave for days 27–29, then I planned to take 3 PTO days 30–31 and 2 days Jan 2–3. The company year-end blackout is Dec 29–Jan 2 — worried I might be forced to use PTO for the blackout days.

josh-engineering: Congrats! For coverage, our team asked people-ops to require at least 1 on-call person during the freeze. But PTO vs unpaid is a People decision. FWIW we can backfill on-call for those days if needed.

ola-people: Ok. Policy recap (short) — standard carryover cap is 40 hours for full-time and is applied on calendar-year basis. For hires after Jul 1 we pro-rate accrual and carryover eligibility. Exceptions can be made for documented relocation or medical reasons with manager + People Ops sign-off.

sam-finance: Adding finance note: if you want to convert unused PTO to cash buyout, we only do that at separation or per fiscal-year buyout window; tax residency can change things if you relocate mid‑year. Recommend checking with payroll after relocation.

maria-people: Understood. What's the process to request a formal exception for carryover? Do I need manager email + relocation docs?

ola-people: Yes — please put a short request thread to people-ops with: 1) manager approval (email OK), 2) relocation confirmation (move dates, visa/lease doc optional), 3) which exact days you want carried over and estimated hours. We'll review and tag People Ops Lead.

maria-people: Cool — drafting that now. If approved, do carried hours stay in old currency accrual or convert to local policy once I'm Spain-based?

sam-finance: We'll typically keep the accrual hours on the employment record as USD-hours until separation; post-transition payroll/local benefits might have different leave rules. We'll coordinate with payroll to mirror anything necessary.

ola-people: Also note the blackout exception rubric: we can approve exceptions when coverage is arranged and manager confirms no business-critical commitments. If you're returning Jan 6, that looks fine.

maria-people: Thanks. One more: if carryover is granted, can I use carried hours immediately after move (Jan 6) or is there a waiting period?

ola-people: No waiting period once approved — carried hours are available as soon as we update the system, but we'll confirm dates in the final approval message.

josh-engineering: If you want, tag me in the manager approval email and I can confirm coverage scheduling.

maria-people: Appreciate it — will send docs + manager note in an email to people-ops@redwood.com and paste the approval here. Thanks all :smile:

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice: no major deployments expected between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-03.

ola-people: Thanks @deploy-bot — that should make approvals easier. I'll review once I get your email, Maria.

maria-people: Sent the email with manager approval and a copy of the relocation booking. Tagging here for visibility: @ola-people @josh-engineering @sam-finance

ola-people: Got it. I'll follow up with a formal exception response within 48 hours. :thumbsup:
